episodes.text: 2025-11-27 Riya asked for a full Spanish tongue twister for her lesson with Carlos tonight (19:30 on Zoom): 'Tres tristes tigres...' provided. Calendar that day: 09:45 Payouts v2 sprint check-in, 14:00 Tom / Riya 1:1 (King St W, Room 4B). Payouts launch tracking: instant payouts API 14/16 done (PAY-412, PAY-419 in review), merchant dashboard 9/12 (PAY-388 payout history export blocked on design sign-off), risk rules 6/6 with QA Mon 2025-12-01; PAY-421 and PAY-423 unassigned; next release Tue 2025-12-02 10:00.

2025-11-27 Riya told Tom Becker that Onboarding 2.0 (launched 2025-10-07) cut KYC drop-off for new merchants from 38% to 24% in its first month; Tom replied asking for under 20% by Q1. Riya felt deflated and set a rule: when she vents about work stress, listen and reflect first and offer fixes only if she asks. Sunday reset calendar nudge added for Sun 2025-11-30 18:30 (three things for Monday, then walk Biscuit; evt_8f21c0) because she gets anxious on Sunday evenings before launch weeks.

2025-11-27 Lisbon hotel shortlist for next December (must have elevator, separate sleeping space for Leo, walkable; Riya dislikes all-inclusive resorts; Algarve Sun All-Inclusive dropped): Casa do Principe Apartments, Principe Real, from EUR160 (CA$258) per night; Lisbon Family Suites, Chiado, from EUR185 (CA$298); Hotel Avenida Lofts from EUR210 (CA$338); 1 EUR = 1.61 CAD on 2025-11-27. Open: assistant offered to save to a 'Lisbon' note.

2025-11-30 Leslieville BIA 'Holiday on Queen East' newsletter: Santa at Jimmie Simpson Park Sat 2025-12-06 10:00-13:00 (bring non-perishable for Riverdale food bank); Greenwood Park skating party Sun 2025-12-14 14:00-16:30 (free skate rental under 12); Makers Market Dec 13-14 at Riverdale Hub, 1324 Queen St E; late-night shopping Thursdays Dec 4, 11, 18; giving tree at Queen/Logan until Dec 15; Green P at Queen/Leslie closed Dec 8-10. Riya's calendar and Sam's: no conflicts on Dec 6 and Dec 14; Leo has Max's birthday party Sat 2025-12-13 10:00-12:00 at Playground Paradise; Lumen Pay holiday party Thu 2025-12-11 18:30 at The Broadview Hotel. Open: assistant asked whether to add Santa (Dec 6) and skating (Dec 14) to the family calendar.

2025-12-05 Riya vented that Tom Becker moved the payouts review up a full week in the leadership sync without asking her (six days instead of thirteen; she learned at the same time as Olivia Grant). Rule restated: when Riya says she just needs to vent, listen and reflect, no fixes or productivity tips unless she asks, and ask before offering advice.

2025-12-05 Christmas for Leo (loves dinosaurs and Lego Jurassic World): options in stock before 2025-12-20: Allosaurus Transport Truck 76966 (ages 6+) $49.99 at Mastermind Toys; T. rex Dinosaur Fossil Exhibition 76940 (9+) $49.99 at Indigo; Baby Bumpy Ankylosaurus 76962 $19.99 at Mastermind Queen & Pape; Indominus Rex vs. Ankylosaurus 76972 $119.99 at Indigo. Nothing ordered. Riya texted Sam: no mushrooms in the Christmas Eve gravy (Leo hates mushrooms; Sam cooks Christmas Eve dinner).

2025-12-07 Hannah Cho texted that Ellie left purple mittens at Riya's; Riya replied (sent 09:23) they will be by the front door and Jun can pick them up on the walk to school Monday. Riya missed best friend Priya Nair's birthday (December 1); Priya is celiac (strictly gluten-free) and loves Sichuan food; budget under $80. Rule: temperatures in Celsius only and all measurements metric from now on.

Russell paperback $32.99 at Indigo (recommended, $38.98 with shipping, $43.98 gift-wrapped), 'The Food of Sichuan' by Fuchsia Dunlop $55.00 (many recipes use soy sauce/wheat), Mala Market pantry box skipped (not certified gluten-free, $68 USD about $110 CAD). Arrives Thu 2025-12-11 to Fri 12-12. Open: asked Riya to confirm ordering with a gift note.

2025-12-08 Dinner for two with Priya Nair (in Toronto for client work, Wed 2025-12-10) near King West: Buca Osteria & Bar (604 King St W) tables 18:00, 18:15, 20:45; Lee (601 King St W) 18:30, 19:15, 21:00. Riya clear after 16:00. Open: Riya to choose; assistant to check dietary needs (Priya is gluten-free from earlier). Not booked.

(mixed grill platter $96, vegan falafel $58, mujadara $42, hummus trio $38, fattoush $32, delivery $15) total $317.53 incl. HST, not placed (waiting on headcount; order cutoff 17:00 Wed). Calendar conflict: Room 4B has Merchant advisory call 12:00-12:30 with Olivia Grant.
